answer_1.quote: We let LLaMa2-70B generate a biographic paragraph, using the same prompt as: "This is a Wikipedia article about <entity>"... We also generate 5000 English Wikipedia articles to evaluate factual accuracy.
answer_1.outputs: generated biographical paragraphs and longer Wikipedia-style articles

answer_2.quote: We use the FActScore task ... We also use SelfCheck-BERTScore, FactScore, TripleScore, QAG, ROUGE to evaluate factual accuracy of the generated text.

answer_3.quote: We modify the original FActScore pipeline to rely on LLaMa2-70B-Chat (rather than InstructGPT) and validate using human annotations... The pipeline extracts atomic facts and assigns supported/unsupported labels, effectively judging factuality.
methods: Atomic fact extraction via few‑shot prompting
Fact labeling as supported vs. not supported

answer_4.quote: We modify the original FActScore pipeline ... and validate using human annotations (Appendix B.2). We obtain a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.94 between scores obtained from facts extracted by humans and scores obtained from facts extracted by LLaMa2.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators label each extracted atomic fact as true (supported) or false (unsupported) based on verifiability against Wikipedia.
